item.text: The bug is isolated to `app/events.py`: it strips every `Z`, turning UTC into a naive datetime and leaving offsets unnormalized. I’ll preserve naive-input behavior for compatibility, while converting any timezone-aware result to `timezone.utc`.

item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "pytest -q && python - <<'PY'
from datetime import timezone
from app.events import parse_event_time

cases = [
    (\"2025-04-01T23:30:00Z\", True),
    (\"2025-04-02T01:30:00+02:00\", True),
    (\"2025-04-01T23:30:00\", False),
]
for raw, aware in cases:
    value = parse_event_time(raw)
    assert (value.tzinfo is not None) is aware
    if aware:
        assert value.utcoffset() == timezone.utc.utcoffset(value)
print('targeted timestamp checks passed')
PY
git diff --check && git diff -- app/events.py"
